candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — Slovenian national public procurement notice portal
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication venue under ZJN-3 for all above-threshold contract notices by Slovenian contracting authorities, including state financial bodies (UJP, FURS, Ministrstvo za finance, SID banka, Kapitalska družba). Tenders for payment services, card personalisation, payment gateway support, core banking/IT maintenance and IT staff augmentation reveal headcount plans, insourcing/outsourcing shifts and reorganisations inside public financial bodies that no press release covers.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login required for reading notices
candidates.legal_status: official state publication; notices are public information of public character
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled search/scrape of notice list filtered by contracting authority (UJP, FURS, MF, SID, KAD) and by CPV codes (66xxxxxx financial/banking services, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30162000 smart cards); also pull the machine-readable equivalents from OPSI datasets to avoid heavy scraping
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from UJP/SID procurement pages that point here as the statutory venue
queries_used: portal javnih naročil eJN plačilne storitve razpis banka
Uprava RS za javna plačila UJP javna naročila razpis kartično poslovanje plačilni promet

candidates.source_name: e-JN — Informacijski sistem e-Javno naročanje (bid submission system)
candidates.why_relevant: The mandatory e-submission system paired with the notice portal; hosts the live list of active procurements and the tender documentation packages. Documentation (razpisna dokumentacija) is where role profiles, required FTE counts, seniority and skill profiles for IT staff-augmentation lots are actually specified — the richest hiring/organisation signal in the public-sector route.
candidates.access_status: public reading of active-procurement list; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OPSI dataset 'Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v Informacijskem sistemu e-JN' over scraping; fetch attached documentation only for shortlisted notices
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query; confirmed as the ZJN-3 e-submission system in multiple official descriptions
queries_used: portal javnih naročil eJN plačilne storitve razpis banka

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU procurement journal), Slovenia filter
candidates.why_relevant: All Slovenian above-EU-threshold contracts must also appear on TED, with structured English summaries, CPV codes, buyer identifiers and award notices naming the winning supplier. Award notices (obvestilo o oddaji naročila) reveal which vendor now staffs a public financial body's payment/IT function — a direct organisation-change signal and a competitor-tracking signal.
candidates.source_subtype: supranational procurement journal with open API
candidates.access_status: public, free; documented search API available
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED search API with country=SI and CPV filters (66110000 banking services, 66172000 payment transaction processing, 72xxxxxx IT services); poll daily, store both contract notices and award notices
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query; cross-confirmed by Slovenian procurement guidance describing TED as the above-threshold venue
queries_used: TED tender Slovenia payment services banking contract notice ted.europa.eu

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Odprti podatki Slovenije: Evidenca javnih naročil / oddanih javnih naročil datasets
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable dumps of the procurement record — notices, awards and award decisions — which make longitudinal tracking of a buyer's spend on payment/IT services (and therefore of insourcing vs outsourcing of staff) cheap and reliable, without scraping the HTML portal.
candidates.legal_status: open data licence (national open data portal)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic dataset download via CKAN API; join buyer names against an actor list of state financial bodies
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from procurement portal into open-data catalogue
queries_used: "statistika javnih naročil" Slovenija odprti podatki OPSI javna naročila dataset enarocanje

candidates.source_name: STATIST — public procurement statistics application (OPSI)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregated view of Slovenian procurement since 2013 by buyer, procedure type and supplier. Useful for baselining a state financial body's normal spend pattern so that an unusual staff-augmentation or payment-services tender stands out as a reorganisation signal rather than routine renewal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/periodic analyst use for baselining; not a streaming source
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from OPSI search
queries_used: "statistika javnih naročil" Slovenija odprti podatki OPSI javna naročila dataset enarocanje

candidates.source_name: UJP — Uprava RS za javna plačila, javne objave / delovna mesta
candidates.why_relevant: UJP is the state payments administration; it is legally required to publish javni natečaj vacancy notices and selection outcomes here. Observed example: a public call for a PODSEKRETAR post for information security (DM 5201), naming the organisational unit and pay grade — direct evidence of headcount and internal structure in the state's payment infrastructure operator.
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication under ZJU (Zakon o javnih uslužbencih)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the javne-objave listing weekly; parse the linked PDF/DOC vacancy texts for role title, unit (notranja organizacijska enota), pay grade and deadline
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query, then snowball into the gov.si asset PDF of the actual vacancy text
queries_used: javni natečaj za zasedbo delovnega mesta Uprava RS za javna plačila UJP

candidates.source_name: UJP JN Plačila portal (jnplacila.si) — reporting of payments under public contracts
candidates.why_relevant: UJP-operated portal where contracting authorities publish concluded public contracts and monthly reports on payments executed under them. Payment flows to a named IT/payments vendor over time are a proxy for how much of a public financial body's function is contracted out and when a contract is ramping up or being wound down.
candidates.access_status: public reading; reporting side requires authority login
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic query by contracting authority; cross-join with procurement award notices to date contract start/stop
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query snowball from UJP service documentation

candidates.why_relevant: Central aggregation of javni natečaj notices across all state administration bodies, filterable by organisation. Single crawl point covering UJP, FURS, Ministrstvo za finance and other state financial bodies at once, rather than polling each site.
candidates.access_status: public; exact listing URL not pinned in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate and pin the gov.si 'Delovna mesta' listing endpoint, then crawl with filter Tip objave = Javni natečaji and organisation filter for financial bodies

candidates.why_relevant: Official explanation of where javni natečaj notices must be published and by whom, plus the entry point into the central vacancy database. Essential for building a legally-grounded crawl map of statutory vacancy publication for state financial bodies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to build the publication map; re-check annually or after legal changes
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query snowball

candidates.why_relevant: FURS is the largest state financial body (~3,600 staff) and publishes its javni natečaj notices and vacancy PDFs, including IT/informatika roles. Vacancy volume and role mix in its IT service is a leading indicator of tax/payment system modernisation programmes and of in-house vs contracted capacity.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the zaposlitev page and the gov.si FURS 'Delovna-mesta-objave' asset directory; parse vacancy PDFs for unit and role

candidates.source_name: SDH — Slovenski državni holding, aktualno/novice and nadzorni svet pages (governance appointments)
candidates.why_relevant: SDH manages the state's stakes in financial companies and publishes javni razpis calls for management-board members and the accreditation/nomination pipeline for supervisory-board members. These are the earliest formal signals of leadership change at state-influenced banks, insurers and financial entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the aktualno/novice feed and the nadzorniki (accreditation/nomination) section; watch for 'javni razpis za člana uprave' and 'imenovanje' items

candidates.why_relevant: Annual reports document the kadrovska komisija's activity and board changes across state-held financial companies, giving a consolidated retrospective of leadership moves and governance reorganisations that scattered news items miss. Also anchors the actor map of state-owned financial entities.
candidates.legal_status: statutory report to the National Assembly
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download and text extraction; also fetch Letni načrt upravljanja (LNU) for forward-looking intent (note: parts are marked business secret)
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from SDH governance search

candidates.why_relevant: The central bank publishes its own recruitment calls (kadrovski razpisi) rather than javni natečaj. candidates.why_relevant: Review decisions on contested public procurements expose, in unusual detail, the technical requirements, staffing/personnel-reference criteria and bidder identities of banking/payment/IT tenders — including specifics that the published notice summarises away. candidates.why_relevant: Shows actual transactions of public institutions and state/municipality-owned companies for goods, services and salaries. Following the money from UJP/FURS/SID to named payments and IT vendors reveals contracted headcount and outsourcing relationships that never appear as a vacancy, and dates when engagements start or stop.
candidates.source_subtype: anti-corruption transparency application over public payments

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS — razglasni del (historic venue for javni natečaji and razpisi)
candidates.why_relevant: Until 28 February 2026 the razglasni del was the statutory venue for public calls, tenders and job competitions, so it is the authoritative ARCHIVE for historical baselines of state financial bodies' hiring and tendering. Per an official notice, from 1 March 2026 this content moved to proposers' own websites or the central government site — so it is now an archive plus a pointer to the new publication regime.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Backfill crawl of razglasni del up to Feb 2026 for historical baseline; after that, rely on gov.si/proposer sites. Verify the 2026 change against the primary legal source before relying on it

candidates.why_relevant: The Court of Audit audits UJP, FURS, the Ministry of Finance and state-owned financial entities; its reports describe organisational structure, staffing shortfalls, IT project failures and procurement irregularities in far more depth than any notice. It also publishes its own javni natečaj vacancies, confirming the statutory pattern.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword search of the audit report archive for auditee names (UJP, FURS, SID, SDH) and for 'informacijski sistem', 'kadrovanje', 'javna naročila'

negative_findings.description: Multiple sources indicate that from 1 March 2026 the razglasni del of Uradni list RS no longer publishes javni razpisi, javni natečaji and similar announcements; such content moved to the proposer's own website, or to the central government website where the proposer has none.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historic single-venue crawl of Uradni list is no longer sufficient for 2026+ coverage; publication is now fragmented across institutional sites and gov.si. Not independently verified against the primary legal act in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector built on Uradni list alone would silently go blind from March 2026 onward for exactly the statutory job notices this cell depends on.

negative_findings.description: No specific live Slovenian public-sector tender for 'card personalisation', 'payment gateway support' or explicit IT staff-augmentation at UJP/FURS was surfaced by search-engine queries in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines do not index the enarocanje.si/e-JN notice bodies well; the hypothesis is that such notices exist but are only discoverable through the portals' own search and CPV filters, not via general web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that the collection method for this cell must be portal-native (CPV/buyer filters, OPSI datasets, TED API) rather than web-search-driven; a web-search-only collector would produce false negatives.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL of the central GOV.SI 'Delovna mesta' vacancy listing with the 'Tip objave = Javni natečaji' filter was described in results but no canonical listing URL was captured.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the descriptive eUprava page and individual institution pages were pinned; the aggregator endpoint remains a hypothesis to resolve by browsing gov.si directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: That aggregator would collapse many per-institution crawls into one; leaving it unresolved forces redundant per-body polling.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public procurement or vacancy publication route was identified in this pass for Bankart d.o.o. (the domestic card processor) or for Bank Assets Management Company successors, despite their central role in Slovenian payments.
negative_findings.result_summary: These entities are bank-owned rather than classic budget users, so they may fall outside ZJN-3 publication duties; treated as an open question, not as an absence of activity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a key payments processor is outside the public-publication perimeter, the public-sector route structurally cannot see its hiring or reorganisation, and another workstream must cover it.

negative_findings.description: No confirmation was found of a documented open API or bulk export for ESS (Zavod RS za zaposlovanje) vacancy data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the human-facing job-search interface was located; bulk access is unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether ESS can be a cheap primary feed or only a manual-check secondary source.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV-code map for banking/payments/IT-staffing procurement in Slovenia has not been fixed. Without an agreed CPV list (e.g. 66110000 banking services, 66172000 payment transaction processing, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30162000 smart cards, 79600000 recruitment services), portal and TED queries will be ad hoc and non-reproducible.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and freeze a CPV allowlist for this cell, validate it against a sample of known past Slovenian financial-body awards, then wire it into both the TED API query and the OPSI dataset filter.

coverage_gaps.description: The actor list of Slovenian state / state-influenced financial entities is only partially enumerated here (UJP, FURS, MF, Banka Slovenije, SID banka, SDH, KAD, Modra zavarovalnica). Missing candidates include NLB and other SDH-held banks and insurers, AJPES, KDD, ZPIZ, and the Ministry of Finance's directorates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the full portfolio table from the latest SDH Letno poročilo o upravljanju kapitalskih naložb and from the gov.si state-authorities register, then use it as the buyer/employer filter list for all portal queries.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: javni natečaj notices and razpisna dokumentacija are Slovene-only; only TED provides English summaries, and those omit the staffing detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Slovene as the primary collection language and build a Slovene keyword lexicon (javni natečaj, uradniško delovno mesto, kadrovski razpis, razpisna dokumentacija, kadrovski pogoji, imenovanje, razrešitev, sistemizacija) with machine translation only at the analysis layer.

coverage_gaps.description: The March 2026 shift of gazette announcements away from Uradni list means the pre-2026 archive and the post-2026 stream live in different places, risking a discontinuity in any time series of state hiring/tendering.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill from Uradni list razglasni del up to Feb 2026 and stitch it to the gov.si/institution-site stream from March 2026, recording the source switch explicitly in the collection metadata.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice has been fetched and confirmed live; several (bsi.si/razpisi/kadrovski-razpisi, the gov.si Delovna mesta aggregator, kapitalska-druzba.si over http) are reconstructed from search-result descriptions rather than observed page structure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over every URL here and re-derive canonical paths for the three flagged cases before wiring any collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Robots.txt / terms-of-use posture has not been checked for enarocanje.si, ejn.gov.si, dkom.si, ess.gov.si and the commercial aggregators.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and ToS per domain; prefer OPSI datasets and the TED API wherever they duplicate a scrapable portal, and cap request rates on the rest.

brief: Slovenia's public-sector route to hiring and organisation intelligence in banking/payments rests on two statutory pillars: procurement publication under ZJN-3 (Portal javnih naročil / enarocanje.si, the e-JN system, and TED for above-threshold contracts, all mirrored as machine-readable OPSI datasets) and civil-service vacancy publication under ZJU (javni natečaj notices on UJP, FURS and Ministrstvo za finance pages, aggregated on GOV.SI and duplicated to the ESS employment service). A third, distinctively useful layer is oversight and money-trail infrastructure — DKOM review decisions expose the staffing and technical criteria buried in contested tenders, ERAR exposes actual payments from state financial bodies to named payments/IT vendors, and Računsko sodišče audits describe organisational structure directly; SDH's javni razpisi and annual portfolio reports are the earliest formal signal of leadership change at state-held banks and insurers. The main structural risk for this cell is the reported March 2026 move of gazette announcements off Uradni list RS onto proposers' own sites, which fragments what used to be a single crawlable venue and breaks time-series continuity. Collection should be portal-native (CPV and buyer filters, TED API, OPSI bulk data) rather than web-search-driven, since general search engines index the notice bodies poorly and produce false negatives.
